Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL1336 to include parent and all salts. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary for activity provenance. Filter for IC50 bioactivities with nM units against target CHEMBL279. Return all rows without limit.
